scope: Local performance/logic source review and verified repairs

versions.note: Compatibility versions unchanged; reviewed checkout fixes are not a deployed release.

findings.reproduction: Repeated forecast scans, pressure sorts, getter/schema introspection, root rebuilds, and binary copies.
findings.fix: Reuse response indexes/layouts; combine root patches; use buffer views.
findings.verification: Controlled before/after codec benchmark and opaque-root regression.

findings.reproduction: Repeating the same snapshot produced identical bytes but reported scalar modifications due to Float32 rounding.
findings.fix: Compare values at stored Float32 precision; preserve assignment counts.
findings.verification: test Float32 rounding does not report or rewrite unchanged stored values

findings.reproduction: The vendor swallowed a warning compilation failure; the same old item count falsely passed verification.
findings.fix: Validate responses and compare final decoded alert content.
findings.verification: test failed warning compilation cannot pass verification merely by matching the old count

findings.reproduction: A hit did not update recency in the existing four-entry cache, reparsing a frequently sampled temperature grid.
findings.fix: Move cache hits to the most-recent position; retain capacity.

findings.reproduction: Duplicate conflicting values were overwritten before the mapper could detect ambiguity.
findings.fix: Remove each conflicting point field permanently for that normalization pass.

findings.reproduction: WindDirection=None raised AttributeError and lost otherwise valid forecast fields.
findings.fix: Read direction only when it is a string.

findings.reproduction: Nonfinite and reversed visibility ranges yielded invalid or invented numeric results.
findings.fix: Require finite, ordered values within the existing bounds.

findings.reproduction: Zero QPF resolution and infinite temperature-grid bounds raised errors.
findings.fix: Validate dimensions, resolution and coordinate bounds before sampling.

findings.reproduction: All affected counties were paired with the first hazard, giving another county the wrong warning category.
findings.fix: Match each county to its hazard; deduplicate stable identities including significance; reject empty windows.

findings.reproduction: Missing humidity was treated as zero while claiming a pressure derivation using observed P/T/RH.
findings.fix: Require actual humidity and preserve station-pressure provenance.

findings.reproduction: Backoff used 3600 seconds for all sources, violating the 1800-second QPF limit and rejecting valid file-source stale use. Slow failures used the pre-download age.
findings.fix: Apply the existing dataset-specific stale limit consistently and recheck age after failure.

findings.reproduction: A valid environment key still required a .env file.
findings.fix: Read .env only when an environment key was not provided.

findings.reproduction: Conflicting cumulative duplicates and boolean values could produce numeric rain intervals.
findings.fix: Reject conflicting lead rows and boolean numeric values; preserve valid identical duplicates.

findings.reproduction: An unchanged ETag still rewrote and rehashed all cached subsets.
findings.fix: Retain validation and skip subset writes/hashes on a cache hit.

findings.reproduction: An APCP failure prevented pressure processing for the same lead.
findings.fix: Isolate field failures while retaining the existing two-download concurrency.

findings.reproduction: A Range response was fully buffered before checking its size.
findings.fix: Stop streamed consumption as soon as it exceeds the expected range length.

findings.reproduction: A ClientHello header split into 1/2/3-byte fragments was treated as no SNI and routed to the wrong upstream.
findings.fix: Wait for the complete handshake header.

findings.reproduction: SNI parsing accepted bytes outside the declared handshake/extension boundaries.
findings.fix: Check handshake, extension and SNI-list bounds.

findings.reproduction: Synchronous proof writes blocked the event loop outside the translation timeout; a completed candidate could be confused with a served response.
findings.fix: Use one shielded disk worker within the deadline; correlate encoded candidates with final events; expose proofs only for modified responses.
findings.verification: tests/test_addon.py slow proof and late worker failure; tests/test_api.py serving-outcome visibility

findings.reproduction: The first notification during monotonic uptime below 300 seconds was incorrectly deduplicated.
findings.fix: Apply deduplication only when an earlier notification exists.

findings.reproduction: Read/backup failure after stopping AdGuard left it stopped; partial managed-rule metadata was not restored.
findings.fix: Include read/backup in recovery scope, restart AdGuard, and restore changed metadata.

python.note: The two API regressions followed the final serving-outcome integration fix; unchanged 128-test evidence was reused.

httpSmoke.scope: Ephemeral loopback codec service, normalized synthetic station, retained native binary

realGribReplay.scope: Two copied current +6-hour cached subsets; local ecCodes and modified worker; mocked HEAD only

codec.snapshot: 274 exact hourly thermodynamic/wind samples, 3-hour NWP pressure points; second variant adds Taiwan AQI=20 and empty CWA alerts
codec.measurement: performance.now elapsed batch wall time divided by 100, ms; retained baseline and first post-change raw batch means sorted by value
limitations: Mac microbenchmark only; not Pi energy, CPU temperature, end-to-end latency, or device UI acceptance.

The post-change batch run preceded stricter alert-content verification and zero-copy HTTP buffer changes; the benchmark has zero alerts and calls transform directly, so neither later edit changes its code path.

unchangedWorkerRun.note: This is the work avoided on an unchanged ETag run, not measured storage/power use per day.

readOnlyProductionInspection.services: API, codec, reverse proxy, forward proxy and SNI running; routing active/exited; both timers waiting

preservedContracts: dataset TTLs and existing stale-data limits
exact/coherent mapping and whole precipitation windows
limits: No new native Mac/iPhone/Watch UI acceptance.
No Pi power or temperature measurement; local codec benchmark cannot establish energy savings.
Cached model decoding and nearest-grid lookup remain per-run validation work.
A single timed-out proof worker can finish an encoded candidate; final bridge event establishes serving outcome.
The existing native TAIWAN_AQI scale endpoint limitation remains.
